verdict.rationale: Anytype's developer portal has a featured MCP page describing a server that lets AI assistants work with Anytype's API in natural language, and a probe confirms that official MCP server documentation exists. It sits on top of the localhost API bundled with the desktop app. The evidence is limited to brief snippets. Missing for 10: detailed setup and tool-coverage documentation for the MCP server, client compatibility specifics, and independent or hands-on confirmation that connecting an agent works.
